test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: AHL is related to ELP in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, GMP is related to KQT. To which of the following is FQS related following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- (4) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• 'AHL’ is written as 'ELP'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9bdf4d8d75e58a15e4c4214e1bf19835c52142476f85491e21f185ace31e5f1.png] 

And,

 
• 'GMP' is written as 'KQT'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0de2c3dd06fc73bec9adcea5d3e939608c9d78eca0770515258241132d042c8c.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'FQS' is written as 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5101b96671c7bb24844d79eef8b9b5faa39f017711bc7c1707b0d9b645f0a3ad.png] 

Hence, "**JUW**" is the correct answer.
